audience: auto repair shops that run work orders and appointments in Shopmonkey

useCases.title: List work orders with their status and technicians
useCases.text: The AI lists the shop's work orders with status flags, totals and assigned technicians, and reads one order with its services and line items.

useCases.title: Find a customer, their vehicles and service history
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by search or phone number, lists their vehicles with VIN and mileage, and lists their estimates, repair orders and invoices.

useCases.title: Check which parts are in stock
useCases.text: The AI searches inventory parts by name, part number or SKU. It shows quantity on hand, available and reserved, cost, bin location and vendor.

useCases.title: Add a customer and vehicle and open a work order
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer and a vehicle, then opens a new work order, which starts as an estimate.

useCases.title: Check the calendar or book an appointment
useCases.text: The AI searches appointments by date range, customer, order or technician, and books a new appointment for a customer, vehicle and technicians.

useCases.title: Move a work order to another status or edit it
useCases.text: The AI moves an order to another workflow status or changes its status, complaint, due date or service writer. It can also archive the order.
